ez_unemp.name: Euro area unemployment
ez_unemp.note: Seasonally adjusted, euro area (changing composition); replaces OECD LRHUTTTTEZM156S, which ends Jan 2023

uk_cpi.name: UK CPI (index)
uk_cpi.note: CPI all items (MM23); replaces OECD GBRCPIALLMINMEI, which ends Mar 2025

boe.name: UK short-term interest rate
boe.note: Immediate interbank rate, tracks Bank Rate

jp_cpi.name: Japan CPI (index)
jp_cpi.note: Source series ends mid-2021. TODO: e-Stat (needs an appId) or a Statistics Bureau CSV; OECD also ends 2021-06

cn_cpi.name: China CPI (index)
cn_cpi.note: OECD Prices database (from NBS); replaces the FRED copy CHNCPIALLMINMEI, which ends Apr 2025

jp_rate.name: Japan short-term interest rate
jp_rate.note: Immediate interbank (call) rate, tracks the Bank of Japan policy rate

food.name: Global food price index (IMF)
food.note: IMF primary commodity prices; stands in for the FAO index (no stable CSV endpoint)

gold_eur.name: Gold in euros (€/oz)
gold_eur.note: Gold month-end close divided by the EUR/USD monthly average

hy_spread.name: US high-yield spread (ICE BofA OAS)
hy_spread.note: FRED carries only the latest 3 years (ICE licensing)

real_wages.name: US real median weekly earnings
real_wages.note: Full-time wage and salary workers, quarterly
